title: XML document declares an external DTD in xml — review required
description: A DOCTYPE with a SYSTEM identifier pointing at a remote URL makes any parser that resolves external subsets fetch that URL. The declaration is the XXE surface: it can pull internal addresses or load a DTD that defines further entities. The rule flags the declaration; whether the parser resolves it is a review decision.
remediation: Remove external DTD references, or configure the parser to prohibit DTDs and external entities.
limitation: Lexical: matches a literal http SYSTEM identifier; a file:// or relative SYSTEM id is out of scope.
